purpose: Single manifest of every source the pregame-context layer may read. A source that is not `approved` here CANNOT emit a value, whatever code exists for it. Adding a new external provider or a new dependency requires an approval record in this file with a named approver, a date and a decision record; the layer refuses to run one otherwise.

rules.display_only: No source in this file may alter a projected margin, total or win probability. Factor promotion is governed exclusively by data/factor_registry.json.
approval_required_for: any source needing a new python dependency
rules.unavailable_is_a_value: A source that is missing, stale, low-coverage, conflicting or unapproved renders as an explicit unavailable state. It is never imputed, defaulted or silently omitted.

approval.decision_record: PHASE0_DECISIONS.md; already the schedule spine of the model
PHASE0_DECISIONS.md; per-season conference lookup, never hardcoded
gate 0; talent==0 is a MISSING sentinel (service academies), carried as unranked_recruiting, never as a low score

NO APPROVED SOURCE EXISTS for confirmed/probable QB availability. data/cfbd/qb_starts_*.parquet is a RETROSPECTIVE proxy that reads the week's starter from in-game attempts; factor_registry records that its effect (-3.52 pts) is inflated by in-game reverse causation, and the pregame-knowable variant backup_qb_pregame was REJECTED (p=0.075, n=745). Approving a live availability feed requires: a named provider, a written licence check, a stated update cadence, a confirmed/probable/doubtful/out vocabulary, and a pre-registered pregame evaluation. Until all five exist this family renders unavailable and NO availability adjustment is applied anywhere.

NO APPROVED SOURCE for offensive-line or key-unit availability. research/situational-factors.md flags OL depth as plausibly underpriced; that is a hypothesis, not a measurement. Same five requirements as the QB feed.

NO APPROVED FORECAST PROVIDER and no dependency added. CFBD's weather is OBSERVED, not forecast, and would be post-kickoff for a pregame packet. A forecast provider is a NEW EXTERNAL PROVIDER: it needs a named service, a licence/terms read, a stated refresh cadence, a forecast-issue-time field distinct from observed_at, venue coordinates (which need cfbd_venues first), and a pre-registered evaluation before any weather value could ever leave display-only. Wind, precipitation and temperature fields are contracted here so the panel can show them as unavailable rather than pretending the question was never asked.
